digest.component_or_area: BindingStore baseline persistence and reconciler idempotency
propositions: BindingStore.set_baseline unconditionally wrote baseline_advanced_at timestamp with no production reader, causing 1,144 volatile writes across a 40-revision corpus despite zero baseline value changes.
Two consecutive reconciler passes over unchanged Jira state must produce byte-identical bindings.json and no new git commits.
set_baseline must filter five mirrored fields, preserve keys with None values, and return early when stored baseline equals incoming baseline.
Baseline write-when-changed guard reduces packed-cost delta from 13.84 KiB/version to 2.33 KiB/version (16.8% of baseline), meeting the 25% criterion.
No production code reference to baseline_advanced_at exists after implementation, and all new baseline writes omit the timestamp field.
